data.detailed_description:
X-MiGu Fighters is the follow up to 2017's Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer! (click read more for full discription and features)

IMPORTANT! If you buy this game and play on a Windows 10 System, READ THIS FIRST:
... if you blow this off the game will not run correctly. :D Thanks!

NEW & OUT NOW from X-MiGuplay: BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW



Coming soon from X-MiGuPLAY!



X-MiGu Fighters takes us back to the world of Stripper Anya! 5 years have passed since Anya's clash with Demoniqa.What was once a group of high profile Strippers working for the Triple T is now a group of fierce fighters engaging in the RenMiGu Tournaments. Our top heavy hero Anya competes in the company of her co-dancers Ghost, Lynchu and Esstraya as well as others from new and old alien worlds. They're joined by Magnus, the Guild member that was instrumental in connecting Earth with life from beyond. Take part in each of the 14 character's individual journeys and play through the cohesive story told over 6 seasons of fighting!
X-MiGu Fighters Options Include:
-Tutorial
-Story Mode
-1 Player vs CPU Free Play Mode
-2 Player vs Mode
-3 Difficulty Settings
-Max Rounds Options: 3, 5, or 7
-Graphics Settings Low or High
-Customized Game Pad Controls

X-MiGu Fighters marks X-MiGuPLAY's 2nd PC title which honors the late 90's/2000's arcade fighting game craze. This is a retro inspired 1 on 1 fighting game meant to be played lightheartedly with a comedic approach. Your friends will judge you but we won't! ;) #guiltypleasures

*figures based on online data accessible to X-MiGuPLAY as of 09.25.2019

reviews.review:
Stripper Anya 2: X-MiGuFighters is a niche indie fighting game developed and published by X-MiGuPLAY, LLC that blends retro arcade combat, science-fiction storytelling, and adult-themed content into a single package. As a sequel to the original Stripper Anya, the game expands its universe by introducing an interdimensional fighting tournament where warriors from different worlds compete for glory. Rather than aiming for mainstream appeal, the title embraces its eccentric identity and focuses on delivering a distinctive experience for players who enjoy old-school fighting games mixed with mature themes and unconventional storytelling.

At its core, the game is a one-on-one fighter inspired by the arcade classics of the 1990s. Players choose from a roster of human and alien combatants, each featuring unique attacks, animations, and visual designs. The combat system is accessible and easy to understand, making it possible for newcomers to jump into matches without spending hours memorizing complicated inputs. While the mechanics may not offer the depth or competitive complexity found in genre giants, they provide enough variety to keep battles entertaining. Matches move at a brisk pace, encouraging players to experiment with different fighters and strategies as they progress through the game's various modes.

One of the game's more ambitious aspects is its narrative presentation. The story centers on Anya's continued adventures within the strange and often humorous universe created by the developers. Through dialogue sequences and story-driven events, players learn about the tournament, its contestants, and the larger conflict surrounding the competition. The writing does not take itself too seriously and often embraces campy science-fiction concepts, resulting in a tone that feels playful and intentionally over-the-top. While the narrative is unlikely to impress players looking for deep character drama, it succeeds in providing context and motivation for the battles.

Visually, X-MiGuFighters adopts a style that pays tribute to classic digitized fighting games. Character models are detailed and distinctive, helping each fighter stand out despite the relatively modest production budget. The arenas feature a variety of futuristic and alien-inspired environments that reinforce the game's science-fiction setting. Although some animations can appear stiff and certain visual effects reveal the limitations of a small independent project, the presentation possesses a unique charm. The retro-inspired aesthetic helps create a nostalgic atmosphere while maintaining enough originality to avoid feeling like a direct imitation of older titles.

The adult content is a major component of the overall experience and is deeply integrated into both the game's presentation and themes. Rather than treating mature material as a minor bonus feature, the developers make it a central part of the game's identity. This approach ensures that the title stands apart from conventional fighting games, though it also means the audience will naturally be limited. Players interested in adult-oriented games will likely appreciate the unapologetic commitment to its concept, while others may find the focus distracting from the combat itself.

Another positive aspect is the evident dedication shown by the development team through updates and refinements. Improvements to performance, optimization, and game stability demonstrate ongoing support beyond the initial release. These enhancements help the game run more smoothly across a broader range of hardware configurations and show that the developers remained invested in improving the player experience after launch.

The game's biggest weakness lies in its relatively limited mechanical depth. Veterans of competitive fighting games may quickly discover repetitive tactics and a lack of advanced systems compared to more established franchises. Certain animations and AI behaviors can also feel rough around the edges, reminding players of the project's indie origins. Nevertheless, the game's unusual premise, retro-inspired design, and willingness to embrace its own eccentricity help offset many of these shortcomings.

Stripper Anya 2: X-MiGuFighters is ultimately a game that knows exactly what it wants to be. It combines arcade-style fighting, science-fiction adventure, humor, and adult content into a package that caters to a very specific audience. While it lacks the polish and depth of major fighting game releases, it offers a memorable and distinctive experience that stands out within the indie scene. Players who appreciate unconventional projects and retro-inspired combat may find plenty to enjoy, while those seeking a serious competitive fighter may be left wanting more.

Rating: 5/10

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processador: i3 or higher
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: INTEL HD Integrated Graphics
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 2 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: Regarding the INTEL HD Integrated Graphics Requirement, the newer and higher end processor you have, the better. We've recently updated the game to have a lower resolution setting. When the low graphics setting is enabled, the system requirements drop drastically but some system my still have issues getting to 60 FPS. Lower specification systems may slow down the game speed. If this is your scenario, we encourage you close all other applications and ensure your system is not running any unnecessary processes in the background. A lot of elbow grease was put into this in the hopes that more people can enjoy this game on a variety of PCs.
